subject: Alpine Health: schedule security & compliance architecture review
messages:
From: John Perez <john.perez@alpinehealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: Alpine Health — security & compliance architecture review

Markus,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Alpine Health would like to schedule a focused architecture review with your security/infra leads to validate SOC 2 evidence collection and encryption/audit log design for our pilot. Top items we want covered:
- In-scope systems and artifact mapping for SOC 2
- Encryption at-rest / KMS integration options
- Audit log retention, format, and access controls
- SSO / IdP provisioning and SCIM workflows

Would you and your team be available next week for a 60–75 minute deep-dive? We have security + procurement on the thread (security@alpinehealth.com, procurement@alpinehealth.com).

Proposed windows (ET): Wed 6/16 10:30–12:00, Thu 6/17 14:00–15:30. If none of those work, we can shift.

Appreciate it —
John Perez
Director, IT Security
Alpine Health
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: John Perez <john.perez@alpinehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Alpine Health — security & compliance architecture review

John —

Thanks, happy to run this. Laura (security lead) and Evelyn (solutions architect) will join. We can do a 75-minute session to give time for Q&A. Our immediate asks so we can prepare actionable artifacts: 

- Confirm systems in-scope (ids or brief inventory) or share your SOC 2 scope spreadsheet (CSV is fine)
- Any specific KMS/HSM vendor requirements (e.g., AWS KMS, customer-managed keys)
- Example audit log retention policy and compliance windows
- SCIM/SSO IdP type (Okta, Azure AD, other) and whether you need just a read-only or full provisioning flow

We can cover a suggested artifact mapping (what evidence Redwood can provide vs. customer-supplied artifacts), our encryption model, and log export options.

Availability (PT/ET): Wed 6/16 07:30–09:00 PT (10:30–12:00 ET) — works for us; Thu 6/17 11:00–12:30 PT (14:00–15:30 ET) also OK. Which do you prefer?

Attaching a short pre-read with our proposed agenda and the artifact map template — please review and drop any items you want added.

Attachments: redwood-arch-diagram-v1.pdf (stub), SOC2-in-scope-list.csv (template)

—Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Solutions & Integrations
Redwood Inference

John
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@alpinehealth.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 11:42:00 -07:00

John — thanks for confirming Wed 6/16 10:30–12:00 ET. Calendar invite has been sent from my account (look for "Redwood — SOC2 architecture review (Alpine Health)").

We do not require an NDA to run the architecture review; we will share sanitized samples only. Attached are: access-logs-sample.txt (sanitized sample), and the artifact index template (SOC2-in-scope-list.csv) — please use the template to populate your scope. I also dropped an architecture diagram and working notes in a Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-exAMPLE

Agenda (high level):
- 0–10m intro + participants
- 10–30m artifact mapping & responsibilities
- 30–55m encryption, KMS options, key rotation
- 55–70m audit logs export / retention / access controls
- 70–75m next steps / procurement Qs

If procurement needs a separate pre-meeting to discuss PO timing, happy to take a short sync after the session.

Attachments: access-logs-sample.txt (stub), redwood-arch-diagram-v1.pdf (stub), SOC2-in-scope-list.csv

—Laura
